entries.name: SiriUserSegments
entries.note: private framework, owner Intents; from SDK matrix siri-kit.json
entries.ready_note: Apps declare [[intent]] tables in manifest.toml and serve them on their control socket. Search and the Shortcuts action library list and run an installed app's shortcut intents (shell::intents::runnable_shortcuts). The assistant answers with intent cards that run only after the user confirms them, and reads answers aloud when Speak Answers is on. Voice recognition is not built: nothing turns speech into an intent request, so Siri's spoken requests are not covered.
